name: Zajchik: Put' v odin konec!
source:
Beyond the boundary of the familiar fairy tale begins a different story. This is an alternate story set in the world of [url=/v21418]Zajchik[/url], where your choice becomes the key, and every step leads to a new fork in the road.

You stand on the threshold of a forest where everything has gone differently. The investigation into the mysterious disappearances of children is in your hands. Every dialogue, every decision made irreversibly changes the fabric of reality, bringing you closer either to the light or to the thickest darkness. Will you be able to unravel the mystery hiding in the thicket? And are you ready to learn the truth that this alternate forest holds?

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/club234507304]VK[/url]]
translation:
超越熟悉的童话故事的界限，开始了一个不同的故事。这是一个以 [url=/v21418]Zajchik[/url] 世界为背景的平行故事，你的选择成为关键，每一步都会通向新的岔路。

你站在森林的门口，一切都变得不同了。对儿童神秘失踪事件的调查就在你的手中。每一次对话、每一个决定都会不可逆转地改变现实的结构，让你更接近光明或最黑暗的地方。你能解开隐藏在灌木丛中的谜团吗？你准备好了解这片替代森林的真相了吗？

[翻译自[url=https://vk.com/club234507304]VK[/url]]
